requirements.requirement: The system must compute a sponsor historical trial count using sponsor identifiers derived from ClinicalTrials.gov metadata.
The system must assign a higher historical credibility contribution when a sponsor is associated with multiple trials compared to a single trial.
The system must incorporate trial completion status into historical credibility scoring when such status is available in metadata.
The system must assign higher credibility to sponsors with a greater proportion of completed trials relative to non-completed trials.
The system must normalize the historical credibility score to a 0–1 range before combining with base sponsor type score.
The system must combine base sponsor type score (from EVAL-CT-M4-S2) with historical credibility score using a deterministic weighting formula.
The system must produce the same historical credibility score given identical sponsor metadata inputs (deterministic output).
The system must handle sponsors appearing under slightly different names by applying a normalization or matching strategy before aggregating historical signals.
The system must default the historical credibility contribution to a neutral value when no prior trials are found for a sponsor.
The system must exclude trials with missing or unknown completion status from completion-based calculations without causing failure.
The system must log a warning when sponsor historical data cannot be reliably derived due to missing identifiers.
The system must ensure the final combined sponsor credibility score remains within the 0–1 range after incorporating historical signals.
